# Anchored audio-tour character

Open `/character-map/anchored.html` (or `/character-map/`) to test the anchored character. Only bounded hair, eye and mouth regions move. The original CV portrait remains unchanged.

Choose a narration to load its matching editable script automatically, then generate mouth timing and play the recording. Start `tools/lip-sync/start-workshop.cmd` for local generation; saved ODT script text is refreshed when the launcher starts.

The retired coordinate-map and independently generated split-character previews have been moved outside `dist` into `archive/character-split-2026-10-06/`. They are not part of the website.
